title: A Recipe for the Mixtape
author: Sebastian Crane
blurb: Ulyana Pemberton, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
